findings.description: Direct inspection of current V25 sit and crouch renders shows both shorts thighs remain visible while the apron hangs between or behind the legs; side hems lift around the knees. Front-panel deformation/attachment still fails continuous coverage.

Direct inspection of current V25 views: side folds descend more continuously and rear vertical channels are clearer than V24, but coarse triangular faceting persists across the right/rear skirt and front apron. Surface continuity remains unacceptable.
The rear adjustment tab still blends into the jacket and the buckle has no distinct readable shape in the current back view.
Authored UV mapping is still missing. The mesh topology illustration is not a UV layout.

sourceEvidence.currentPrototypeMotif: V25 changes only the skirt fold displacement field to crease-bound soft box pleats (22% valley half-width and 24% valley-depth ratio) while retaining V24 panels, hem and weights. Direct inspection of five current views and six poses shows locally improved fold paths, but persistent triangular faceting, sit/crouch shorts exposure, lifted side hems, and unreadable rear tab. Authored UVs remain missing; no fit or appearance acceptance is granted.

nextAction: REJECT. Preserve the improved V25 fold paths, but correct surface continuity. Replace front-lap attachment/deformation with a continuous overlapping panel that stays above both raised thighs in sit and crouch; do not add more apron length. Give the rear tab and buckle clear shape/material separation and author/verify real UVs. Rebuild as a new revision and directly inspect all five views and six poses; fit, Shape Keys, Unity/VRChat runtime, package, and release remain unverified.
